subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and fourth term is related to third term.

ABC : EWJ :: JHK : NCR :: PMT : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter → (4) is added to the position values according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (4) is subtracted from the position values according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter → (7) is added to the position values according to the English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• ABC : EWJ

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e9001949cc38c2aafb4760c08c23430751eac6ad236e97aae2ff7d00ddb5788.png] 

And,

 
• JHK : NCR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ec9ebdb8d76c08e96605e074d3d9930265aad08944c747fe0894f9716bafb98.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• PMT : ?

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcb826ab6dbef7b7fe15ae7935f80e3a2b1235556271232d56cdd859b12eb85d.png] 

​Hence, "THA" is the correct answer.
